title: Where to start with Jean Rollin?

commenti.body: *The Iron Rose* is gorgeous and one of my favorite of his films, though it's one of his slower films. *Lost in New York* is another favorite of mine, an underrated surreal fairytale, though it's not much of a horror film. So far the only Rollin film I disliked—and I strongly disliked it!—was *Schoolgirl Hitchhikers*.

You've actually picked the 3 best ones. The Iron Rose has a hazy, dreamlike atmosphere but has very little happening. It's going for a mood and it worked for me. Grapes of Death was solid fun and still had the surreal vibe Rollin is known for and had some good gore effects. Fascination is my favourite, just a perfect blend of sex, blood and psychedelia.

I've only seen two of his vampire moves, 'The Nude Vampire' and 'Requiem for a Vampire'. I need to give these a rewatch as I wasn't too impressed the first time. That's most likely due to not being in the mood for them at the time - they have a deliberately slow and dreamy pacing which puts me to sleep most of the time.

'Lips of Blood' and 'The Living Dead Girl' are also considered his best, but I've yet to see them.

Not one of his most talked about films but I would like to recommend The Night of the Hunted (1980). One of my favorite roles for Brigitte Lahaie and one of those endings that stuck in my head for days after.
